figures.Vis-nylons: The book's nylon-6,6 and nylon-6 schemes and the skateboard photograph; Original figure archived as c12-chem-ch26-fig-nylons (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book calls adipic acid '1,4-hexanedioic acid'; it is hexanedioic (hexane-1,6-dioic) acid.

The comparison of nylon-6 with nylon-6,6 (harder, smoother, more impact resistant, lower melting point) is reported as the book's description. The Quick Check questions are printed without answers; the lesson's answers were derived for it and need the second-person review.
